meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: Spatial statements, including regional rural banks
meta.coverage: Bank deposits and credit in every state and union territory, ₹ lakh crore, every quarter from March 2004 to March 2017
meta.note: RBI quarterly statistics on deposits and credit of scheduled commercial banks, statement 3A (DBIE 1483), including regional rural banks. Summed over bank groups and population groups to each state; by the location of the branch that books the deposit or loan. Dated to the last month of each quarter.
